##### Project general facts

Rove Home Marina, presented by Irth Development, embodies a contemporary residential concept that thrives on clean lines, expansive glazing, and a design that captures abundant light and panoramic city views. The architecture emphasizes a lifestyle‑driven silhouette that maximizes connection to the surrounding urban fabric while delivering a sense of spaciousness. Units range from sleek studios to expansive family apartments, each positioned to showcase the waterfront character.

Residents can dip into a convertible indoor‑outdoor infinity pool, then invigorate themselves with cold plunges or unwind in reflexology zones. Wellness spaces include yoga gardens, a salt‑cave sauna, aroma steam rooms, and a boutique CRANK fitness studio, while entertainment options feature an outdoor cinema, karaoke room, and multi‑sensory pods. These experience‑focused amenities blend relaxation, activity, and community interaction under one roof.

Interiors are curated by Zebra and Studio Feel, offering a modern design‑led aesthetic highlighted by floor‑to‑ceiling windows and panoramic balconies. Smart home technology integrates seamlessly with the living environment, and kitchens arrive fully equipped for immediate use. Furnishings such as sofas, dining sets, lighting fixtures and decorative accents are thoughtfully selected to provide a ready‑to‑live‑in ambience of style and comfort.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Marina stretches along a man‑made canal that winds for several kilometres, framed by a striking skyline of high‑rise towers and luxury waterfront residences. The area buzzes with urban sophistication, where contemporary architecture meets the soothing rhythm of the sea. Residents enjoy immediate access to the iconic Marina Walk, a promenade dotted with cafés, restaurants and entertainment venues overlooking tranquil waters.

Just beyond the promenade, JBR Beach offers golden sands and a vibrant seaside atmosphere, while Marina Promenade presents an array of retail and dining options within strolling distance. The district’s connectivity is reinforced by major thoroughfares that link to the broader city, ensuring effortless travel for work or leisure. Proximity to upscale shopping malls adds a further layer of convenience for fashion, leisure and everyday needs.

The neighborhood’s appeal is amplified by a lively social scene, featuring world‑class restaurants and trendy cafés that attract both locals and visitors. Outdoor enthusiasts benefit from nearby cycling and jogging paths that trace the waterfront, encouraging an active lifestyle. All these elements combine to create a dynamic coastal enclave where convenience, entertainment and breathtaking views coexist.
